causes: `with` statements must use `with resource as name { ... }`.

fixes.title: Rewrite this construct using the currently supported RSScript syntax.

diagnostics.label: return type mismatch
causes: RSScript return types are part of the review contract and must be checked before Rust lowering.

fixes.title: Return a value of type `Result<Unit, String>` here.

diagnostics.summary: resource-producing expression of type `Result<ConfigStore, String>` must be consumed by `with`.
diagnostics.label: resource producer escapes
causes: Resource-producing calls create transient linear values that cannot be stored, returned, retained, managed, or passed as ordinary values.

A resource slot is host-owned: it is acquired at the external boundary and released by the runtime on every exit from its `with` scope. A `.rss` body therefore cannot mint one — a resource constructor in a body, including `return Handle(fd: id)`, is a producer with no owning scope. Declare the producer bodyless in an `.rssi` interface.
